name: GKA-style: best trick per category + overall score (approximation)
description: Tricks grouped into families; only the highest-scoring trick in each family counts, plus an Overall score for the whole heat (wow factor, variety, smoothness, risk, landed-vs-crashed ratio). Height/extremity weighted ~70/30 over technicality. APPROXIMATION of the GKA Kite World Tour Big Air rules as described on the public discipline page — encode the exact GKA Rulebook 2025 Chapter 5 (sections 41-44, Appendix C2) before using this preset for a sanctioned event.
basedOn: GKA Kite World Tour Big Air discipline page + Rulebook 2025 table of contents (gkakiteworldtour.com)

criteria.label: Height & amplitude
criteria.help: Height and distance travelled; emphasis rises with wind strength.

criteria.label: Extremity
criteria.help: Big, high and powered, kite in the power zone at a good angle; speed in / speed out; projection.

criteria.label: Technicality
criteria.help: Difficulty of the manoeuvre (loops, rotations, board-offs, grabs).

impression.label: Overall score
impression.help: Wow factor, variety, smoothness, risk, proportion of tricks landed vs crashed.
